summary: Converting 2019-01-01 00:00 +13 to UTC-13 requires moving back two dates to 2018-12-30 22:00. The old unsigned ordinal could underflow, and year normalization only handled ordinal zero. The fix uses a signed ordinal and preserves excess days when normalizing across year boundaries. This reversal restores only the original zero-only boundary condition, leaving ordinal -1 unnormalized in the regression test. Both regions occur exactly once in their respective Git versions. No tests were run.
